_meta.purpose: Per-fault detection ground truth, so an item can be scored on what a review FOUND rather than on how it GRADED. Severity is a judgement one run can swing; detection is closer to a fact. The one clean effect measured on 2026-08-10 was a detection effect: the Phase 6 ethics row moved ethics-statement detection from 2/5 runs to 5/5. Severity comparisons over the same runs separated nothing.
_meta.provenance: Faults were enumerated from the R1 BASELINE runs only (evals/runs/R1/, build a7c86e6, which predates every change under test), then applied unchanged to later builds. Deriving them from the builds being compared would let the catalogue be fitted to the answer.
_meta.matching: Two levels per fault. `mentioned` = the pattern appears anywhere in the report; `as_finding` = it appears inside a Fatal/Major/Minor Findings section. Report both: a review that discusses a gap in its Methodology Audit but never raises it as a finding has half-noticed it, and that distinction is exactly what a severity count hides.
